settings.faqs:
How do I book an appointment? | You can book online through our booking system, call us directly, or visit us in person. Online booking is available 24/7.
What is your cancellation policy? | We require 24 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows may be subject to a fee.
Can I request a specific provider? | Yes! When booking, you can select your preferred provider. We'll do our best to accommodate your request.
How early should I arrive for my appointment? | Please arrive 10-15 minutes early for your first visit to complete paperwork. For subsequent visits, arriving 5 minutes early is perfect.

Do treatments hurt? | Most treatments cause minimal discomfort. We use numbing cream when appropriate and always prioritize your comfort.
How long do results last? | Results vary by treatment. Injectable treatments typically last 3-6 months, while laser treatments can last several years with proper skincare.
Are your treatments safe? | Yes. All treatments are performed by licensed professionals using FDA-approved equipment and products.
What should I do to prepare for my treatment? | Avoid sun exposure, retinoids, and certain medications before treatment. We'll provide detailed prep instructions during your consultation.

Do you offer package deals? | Yes! We offer treatment packages and membership programs that provide savings compared to individual sessions.
What payment methods do you accept? | We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and offer financing options through CareCredit.
Do you take insurance? | Most cosmetic treatments are not covered by insurance. However, some medical treatments may be covered. Contact your insurance provider to verify.
Can I use my HSA or FSA? | Yes! Many of our treatments qualify for HSA/FSA payment. Check with your plan administrator.

Are your providers licensed? | Yes. All our providers are licensed, board-certified medical professionals with extensive training in aesthetic treatments.
Is your facility clean and safe? | Absolutely. We maintain the highest standards of cleanliness and follow all health department guidelines.
What if I have sensitive skin? | We customize every treatment plan. During your consultation, we'll assess your skin type and any sensitivities to create a safe, effective plan.
Do you use FDA-approved products? | Yes. We only use FDA-approved products and equipment from reputable manufacturers.

Where are you located? | We have locations throughout the city. Visit our Locations page for addresses, hours, and directions.
Are you open on weekends? | Yes! We're open Saturdays and some locations offer Sunday appointments. Hours vary by location.
Do you offer virtual consultations? | Yes. We offer complimentary virtual consultations for treatment planning and follow-up appointments.
Is parking available? | Yes. All locations offer free parking for clients.
